sources.entry: Clear Clipboard Text Format - Easily clear the format of your clipboard text with Clear Clipboard Text Format.

summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app that strips formatting from text currently on the clipboard, so text copied from the web pastes as plain text.
summary.what_it_does: The app adds an icon to the macOS menu bar. Clicking the icon with a primary click clears the text format of the current clipboard contents. A secondary click performs the same clear action. The menu also offers options to launch the app at login and to quit. Users can optionally swap which operation runs on primary versus secondary click. The stated purpose is to remove unwanted preset formatting from text pasted from the web into editors.
use_cases: Paste web text into an editor without its original styling
Remove fonts and colors from copied text
Quickly convert clipboard contents to plain text
Keep a mac utility running at login for clipboard cleanup
how_to_run: Download Clear Clipboard Text Format from the link in the README
notable: Runs from the macOS menu bar with one-click clipboard formatting removal
Secondary click performs the clear action
Optional swap of primary and secondary click actions
Can launch at login from the menu
caveats: The README is brief and does not describe implementation details, supported macOS versions, or how the app is built
Only a download link is given for installation; no build or run instructions are included
